description: osirAgentStatus: Is the user's AI agent (e.g. Hermes) installed and working? Reports install progress, the dashboard URL, and whether the dashboard asks for a login (dashboardProtected - checked live). If an install failed, the message says why and what to do. Requires authentication.

agentId.description: Agent id from osirAgentList or osirAgentDeploy.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAgentStatus
